name: Wolverine Pathways
city: Detroit, Southfield, Ypsilanti and Grand Rapids, MI
what_you_do: A free college prep program. Students meet on Saturdays and for 2 to 4 weeks each summer for classes, camps and internships. Scholars admitted to U-M Ann Arbor or U-M Dearborn get a 4-year tuition scholarship.
grades: Apply in 6th or 9th grade; join in 7th or 10th grade
who_can_apply: Students in 6th or 9th grade with at least a 3.0 GPA (3.2 for 9th graders) who live inside the Detroit Public Schools, Southfield Public Schools or Ypsilanti Community Schools district. The school you attend does not matter. The home page also lists Grand Rapids.
duration: From 7th or 10th grade through 12th grade; up to seven Saturdays a semester plus 2 to 4 summer weeks
deadline_text: The next application window opens in December 2026. Last cycle, Southeast Michigan applications closed February 28, 2026 and Grand Rapids applications closed March 20, 2026.
how_to_apply: Apply online when the window opens in December. Join the mailing list for info sessions. Questions: wp-admissions@umich.edu, (734) 647-3848.
notes: No exceptions are made for the Southeast Michigan deadline. You must keep strong grades and attendance to stay in. In 10th to 12th grade you can pick summer courses, camps or internships.
